title: Get Seller Financial Transactions
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /finance/202309/withdrawals

Method: [GET]

Function Description

Retrieves seller financial transaction records within an optional creation-time range, filtered by the required transaction types.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
create_time_lt int N 1672416002 Unix timestamp representing the end of transactions time range one wants to request
types []string Y WITHDRAW,SETTLE The transaction types to return.
Possible values:
  • WITHDRAW: The seller withdraws the settlement amount to a bank card.
  • SETTLE: The platform settles the amount to the seller.
  • TRANSFER: A platform subsidy or deduction due to platform policies.
  • REVERSE: A withdrawal failure caused by incorrect bank card information.
  • PAYMENT: A payment transaction.
  • REFUND: A refund transaction. | page_size |int |N |20 |The default is 20, it must be positive integer,the range is 1-100 | page_token |string |N |6AsPQsUMvH3RkchNUPPh22NROHkE0D8pmq/N5M1kHYcZmtRyv9aVrNv65W7Q6tFA+7D1ud64MPNz5OaT |The next_page_token returned by the previous response. Omit this parameter when requesting the first page. When paginating, specify create_time_ge and create_time_lt in the first request, then reuse the same types, create_time_ge, and create_time_lt values for every page. | create_time_ge |int |N |1623812664 |Unix timestamp representing the start of transactions time range one wants to request | sign |string |Y |5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c |Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders. | timestamp |int |Y |1623812664 |Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time. |

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/finance/202309/withdrawals?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY&create_time_lt=1672416002&types=WITHDRAW,SETTLE&page_size=20&page_token=6AsPQsUMvH3RkchNUPPh22NROHkE0D8pmq/N5M1kHYcZmtRyv9aVrNv65W7Q6tFA+7D1ud64MPNz5OaT&create_time_ge=1623812664

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^next_page_token string 6AsPQsUMvH3RkchNUPPh22NROHkE0D8pmq/N5M1kHYcZmtRyv9aVrNv65W7Q6tFA+7D1ud64MPNz5OaT Cursor used for searching for more information
^total_count int 1 The total num of the withdraws
^withdrawals []object The list of transaction records matching the request filters.
^^id string EFASDFSAFDA23432DFAFDSA A unique transaction ID generated by TikTok Shop.
^^type string WITHDRAW The transaction type.
Possible values:
  • WITHDRAW: The seller withdraws the settlement amount to a bank card.
  • SETTLE: The platform settles the amount to the seller.
  • TRANSFER: A platform subsidy or deduction due to platform policies.
  • REVERSE: A withdrawal failure caused by incorrect bank card information.
  • POLICY_VIOLATION_DEDUCTION: A deduction for a policy violation.
  • REWARD: A reward transaction.
  • PAYMENT: A payment transaction.
  • REFUND: A refund transaction.
  • UNKNOWN: An unrecognized transaction type. | ^^amount |string |100 |The transaction amount, in the currency specified by currency. | ^^currency |string |IDR |The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. | ^^status |string |PROCESSING |The processing status of the transaction. Possible values:
  • SUCCESS: The transaction completed successfully. For a WITHDRAW transaction, this means that the withdrawal has been transferred to the seller.
  • INIT: The withdrawal was initialized. This status applies only to WITHDRAW transactions.
  • ORDERED: The transaction order was created.
  • PROCESSING: The withdrawal is being processed.
  • RECEIVED: The withdrawal was received.
  • PROCESSED: The payout completed successfully.
  • FAILED: The payout failed.
  • REVERSED: The transaction was refunded.
  • EXCEPTION: The transaction was partially refunded.
  • CLOSED: The transaction was closed.
  • UNKNOWN: The status could not be mapped. | ^^create_time |int |1623812664 |The transaction creation time, expressed as a Unix timestamp in seconds. |
